name: html-email
description: A hand-authored, zero-dependency cross-client HTML email framework that never drops support for the oldest clients.

scripts.build: node framework/build/build.mjs && node framework/build/build.mjs --production --out ../dist/email.min.html && node scripts/build-template.mjs templates/cairn-wellness && node scripts/build-template.mjs templates/ferry-street-brewing && node scripts/build-template.mjs templates/lantern-and-quill && node scripts/build-template.mjs templates/voltline && node scripts/build-template.mjs templates/meridian-advisory
scripts.lint: node framework/build/lint.mjs framework/dist/email.html && node framework/build/lint.mjs templates/cairn-wellness/dist/email.html && node framework/build/lint.mjs templates/ferry-street-brewing/dist/email.html && node framework/build/lint.mjs templates/lantern-and-quill/dist/email.html && node framework/build/lint.mjs templates/voltline/dist/email.html && node framework/build/lint.mjs templates/meridian-advisory/dist/email.html
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint
scripts.assets: node scripts/generate-cairn-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-ferry-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-lantern-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-voltline-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-meridian-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run verify && npm run test:lint

author: David Condrey
